creator: Unity specialist (GitHub Copilot), original renderer geometry and presentation for Stephen Long
licenseDisposition: Original project contributions retain the pending owner-license disposition. Imported artwork below is separately CC0-1.0; no blanket MIT grant is implied.
originalProceduralAssets: Original rounded/beveled tile, die and table meshes, unit box and horizontal quad
Original point-stick values, EAST marker and anti-aliased die pip textures
Original rounded-stroke vector ASCII public labels and assist-label rasterization; no imported font
Original directional/specular surface shading, fabric tint/vignette, rail grain, soft contact shadows and outline cues

importedArtwork.creator: FluffyStuff
importedArtwork.whiteDragon: Index 31 / Haku is deliberately entirely transparent: an ordinary visible ivory body, never an unknown-face sentinel.

transformations.generationDependency: Pillow (offline only; runtime and validation need no image/font package)

atlases.packing: Source full 600x800 resampled to 168x224 with Lanczos, preserving 3:4 artwork inside native 2:3 cells. Cell 0 is at the PNG bottom left; glyph top points to +Z on the face quad. Transparent gutters remain; the material composites on matching ivory.
atlases.uv: Half-texel inset of each full cell. Padding, trilinear mipmaps and clamped edges avoid adjacent glyph bleed at playable scale.
atlases.assistLabels: Second atlas adds small original antialiased rounded-stroke labels in the lower letterbox, not a replacement glyph or an OS font.

backs.recolorFormula: RGB channel = palette channel * (0.62 + 0.38 * source red / 255); preserve source alpha, rounded panel and shading; then Lanczos to168x224 inside192x288.
backs.identityBoundary: Back styles stay separate from all 37 face indices; no per-face rear patterns.

importedTable.creator: ambientCG (formerly CC0 Textures)
importedTable.transformation: Byte-identical existing fork JPEG; material-only neutral-luminance teal tint and tiled UVs. Earlier ambientCG-to-fork processing is unspecified; this is not a fresh PBR bundle.

runtimeBudget.compression: Unity normal-quality automatic compression, with a bounded RGBA fallback on unsupported hardware.
runtimeBudget.sourceOriginals: The 38 PNGs and SVG masters are provenance inputs outside Resources; never loaded individually in the player.
runtimeBudget.rendering: Built-in pipeline, single-sample camera targets without MSAA render/resolve buffers, no HDR/postprocessing/URP or realtime shadow maps. Shared meshes and four plain/felt/wood/decal material paths, vertex-interpolated satin lighting, original analytic contact shadows and unchanged mip-filtered artwork. Per-texture anisotropy is enabled rather than forced9x: atlas/backs retain1x and fabric is capped at2x in the player; original files and importer metadata are unchanged.

excluded: legacy GLB/Blender geometry of unverified rights
Majsoul, sample FBX/scenes, Photon, DOTween, third-party fonts, sounds and SDKs
engineComponents: Unity runtime/compiler, UnityCG include, Newtonsoft and Test Framework retain their own terms.
